findings.fact: The player animation classifier's block predicate tests command-button bit 0x08000000.
findings.evidence: 0x1016bb50 calls 0x10160ec0 before stationary/moving classification. The helper requires FL_ONGROUND, an active weapon whose +0x5a0 capabilities include 0x18000, and player+0x2088 bit 0x08000000 before returning true.
findings.consequence: Joining this bit to the client button pack identifies the block verb without relying on default bindings.
